rows.heading: Station Tenure Norms
rows.quote_snippet: 3.1 Minimum Station Tenure: The minimum normal tenure of an executive at any station shall be 3 (three) completed years. 3.2 Normal Rotation Window: Normal rotation of an executive shall be considered upon completion of 3 to 5 years at a work centre.
